name: סְדֹם
summary: Sodom is the city, named with Gomorrah on the Canaanite boundary, where Lot lived. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: בֹּאֲכָה סְדֹמָה means “as you go toward Sodom” and gives the direction of the boundary.
יֹשֵׁב בִּסְדֹם means “living in Sodom” and identifies where Lot lived.

note: Moved from the former word entry `sedom` (old root key סדמ).
